title: Hymn-License Clerk
text: Hymn-License Clerk demands proof that every spoken frequency has been approved by the Glass Prophet's registry. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Unlicensed breathing is still a violation.

defeatReward.text: Hymn-License Clerk is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
